titleEvidence.grammar: Short evaluative participle plus the scientific quantity being tested. The body does not restart the topic.

voiceFragments: Dataset: LongBench Writer(120 prompt), AIME(30 prompt)

paragraphGrammar.cadence: One compact condition line with an inline role lead and paired conditions.
A direct result joined to its reported limitation/explanation; one natural wrap is supported, without a new narrative introduction.

bodyEvidence.scope: Verbatim fragments establish voice only; none is a reusable scientific claim. In particular best must be replaced by the supported comparison scope.

proseTokens.structure: Two ordinary peer bullets: compact conditions, then connected scoped observation/limitation. No standalone report headings.

families.workingCadence: Short evaluative title, one compact condition note, then one direct observation connected to its limitation. Preserve qualifiers within the observation; remove the topic restart and documentary narrator. Let intact evidence retain its detailed conditions and method labels.
doNotAdd: A second experiment-purpose sentence under the topic title
A third-person account of the researcher for internal working observations
A prose inventory of every condition or method already delivered in the evidence
A new role-heading or explanatory-gloss tier absent from the selected grammar
doNotCopy: Scientific names, counts, values or claims from the reference
The source result beyond its supported average and comparison set
Grammar roughness or categorical causal language as an authorship device

titleEvidence.grammar: Short topic plus an overview role; method identity remains in the inline goal rather than expanding the title.

voiceFragments: For example, draft sequence 1 is better than draft sequence 2.

paragraphGrammar.cadence: Inline bold goal lead, plain connector, selectively bold method phrase, plain sentence end.
Two short parallel action clauses under the goal.
Standalone bold role at the same body type level.
Bold inline relation lead followed by a continuous causal/objective explanation.
One subordinate example follows its parent argument; the small sketch supplies the comparison.

proseTokens.roleHeadingStyle: Inline goal lead; standalone motivation role; inline relation lead
proseTokens.roleHeadingWeight: Selective bold at the ordinary body type level
proseTokens.structure: Inline goal introduction; two short peer objective bullets; motivation role; continuous parent argument with one nested example. Simple local object labels.

families.workingCadence: An overview title introduces a specific inline goal and a short objective list. One connected motivation develops through an inline relation lead and subordinate example. The example carries the interpretation; the inset needs only labels or a compact state mapping necessary for recovery.
doNotAdd: A long title that absorbs the inline goal identity
Separate equal-weight headings replacing the selected inline leads
A detached question that splits the parent motivation from its example
Repeated explanation across the example, count subtitles, legend and a concluding takeaway
doNotCopy: Method identity, objective content or token counts from the reference
Grammar roughness as an authorship device
An achieved-performance claim inferred from a stated goal
Implicit color meaning when current facts require a recoverable mapping
